caption:
Your body has seven doors. Say the line for each one, out loud, from the floor up.

Save this and open one door a day. Comment the one you needed most.

Chakras: yoga and Hindu tantra. Verb frame: Anodea Judith, 1987.

Link in bio.
by NMR
#chakras #affirmations #sevendoors #naos
